# Pangaea (pangaea.blog)

> Adam Pang's personal publication for essays.

Pangaea is an independent body of work made in public and kept on an owned URL. Published articles are free to read. There is no paid plan, subscription, or paywall. The homepage is a directory of the published essays. Unfinished drafts are not public. The podcast is not a public route.

Use Pangaea to read Adam Pang's published essays. The site is built with Astro and deployed on Vercel. The git repository is the content system.

## Key links
- [Home](https://pangaea.blog/): the essay directory, with number, title, and date.
- [Posts](https://pangaea.blog/posts/): the same essay directory.
- [Graph](https://pangaea.blog/graph/): a force-directed network of all posts and their wiki-links.
- [About](https://pangaea.blog/about/): who operates Pangaea and why it exists.
- [Contact](https://pangaea.blog/contact/): the real contact path for corrections and questions.
- [Privacy](https://pangaea.blog/privacy/): PostHog analytics, fonts, embeds, cookies, local storage, and external services.

## About
- Pangaea is operated by Adam Pang.
- Adam's canonical public profile: https://adampang.com/about
